evidence_boundary: Local source and test evidence only. No hosted access, deployment, proposal or capital mutation was attempted. PERSONA_EVALUATOR_PAPER_POOL_ID is unset by default, so the cycle stays inactive until an operator configures a paper pool.

design.trigger: persona-evaluator-agent paper_cycle_once, after run_once on every interval; acts only when a quarter before the current one has a persisted ranking snapshot (state.latest) and no applied cycle is recorded
design.route: evaluator POST /bff/management/allocation-policy/evaluate (authority_mode=governed_paper_quarterly_cycle, operator) -> existing CapitalOwnerWriter.evaluate_allocation -> Capital owner POST /api/allocation-evaluations; no new BFF route or adapter method (keeps the task artifact contract)
design.owner_cycle: services/capital/main.py run_paper_allocation_cycle: recompute from the admitted snapshot, policy persona-paper-quarterly-allocation-v1, create one rebalance proposal per tenant+quarter+pool, apply automatically inside the paper ledger (approval_ref paper-auto:<id>), receipt + audit_ref + rollback_target
design.idempotency: rebalance_id derived from tenant|quarter|pool; an existing cycle is returned, an unapplied one is only completed; evaluator also records applied cycles in its state
design.policy: calculate_paper_competition_allocations reuses calculate_target_allocations (score share, tier caps S25/A15/B8, +25% increase cap, exclusions) with paper_running as the positive stage; retained weight of held allocations without a line (departed/skipped personas) is reserved and targets are scaled down (paper_total_budget_scale) so the projected owner portfolio never exceeds 1.0; the owner also refuses any cycle whose projection would exceed it
design.pool_health: evaluator derives risk_budget_factor = min(1, gross_utilisation/budget_full) and capacity_factor only from the O-21 capacity fact (budget full plus admitted candidates waiting). No persisted source for that fact exists in pool health, so capacity_factor stays 1.0 with reason capacity_observation_unavailable and status is partial/unavailable, never known; idle_day_share is not substituted (O-21/AC4 fallback)
design.real_capital_unchanged: calculate_target_allocations defaults, real evaluate endpoint, human approval and apply path are untouched; factor fields are context fields only for the paper quarterly policy; the cycle refuses non-paper pools, non-dev environments and non-paper lines

decisions_for_review: capacity_factor stays 1.0 with a recorded reason because the addendum's capacity fact (budget full plus admitted candidates waiting) has no persisted source yet; when one is published the evaluator should consume it. Regression covers known utilisation and idle share with absent capacity facts
Only the latest closed quarter with a persisted snapshot is cycled; older missed quarters are not replayed
The evaluator's BFF token must carry the operator role (and tenant scope) to call the write route; no token change was made here
Personas without paper_ledger_id on the ranking item or without exactly one active paper_owner binding are skipped with a recorded reason (simulation.skipped); no eligible persona refuses the cycle
With three tier-3 personas the 8% tier cap leaves most of the paper pool unallocated; this is the existing policy, not changed here

The cycle trigger reuses the existing evaluation route and owner endpoint (mode switch) instead of new routes, to stay inside the declared task artifact contract; a dedicated route can be split out later if reviewers prefer
